title: Surface Stability & Golden Paths: SDK/API Go‑Live Orchestration for Function-Calling, Structured Output, Streaming
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Coordinated PM workstream to take the combined SDK + HTTP surface (function-calling, structured output, streaming) from final engineering sign-off to public GA. Focus is on stability guarantees (golden paths), clear migration guidance, deterministic release notes, canonical sample kits, and cross-team GTM handoffs. Deliverables must reduce integration regressions for existing customers and provide unambiguous compatibility contracts for new adopters.

2026-02-28: Canonical sample kit v1 (JS/Python) ready for review

2026-03-14: Internal canary with Solutions & Early Partners
2026-03-28: GA announcement and deprecation of beta flags
deliverables: Migration guide comparing legacy endpoints and new structured output shapes
JS and Python canonical sample kits with streaming + function-calling examples
Compatibility matrix (runtime versions, SDK versions, quantized variants)
Telemetry dashboards for canary cohorts and error budgets
Support triage doc and escalation runbook

test_matrix: SDK permutations: JS v1.x, JS v2.x, Python v1.x, Python v2.x
Workloads: short-chat (<=128 tokens), long-chat (>=2048 tokens), embedding-only
Modes: streaming + non-streaming, function-calling with/without tool sandbox
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (internal): feature flags enabled for Redwood internal orgs
Phase 1 (partner canary): 3 early partners + 2 solutions customers; monitor errors & latency
Phase 2 (open beta): opt-in for all existing customers; docs and migration guide public
Phase 3 (GA): default route, banners for any breaking contract changes and deprecations
Canary cohort sizing: start with 2% of requests routed to new handlers, double every 24 hours if error budget > 99.9%
rollback_triggers: API-level errors > 0.5% for 30m in canary cohort
Median streaming latency regression > 40% vs baseline over 30m
5+ unique customers reporting functional regressions within 2 hours
